Case reference: 2005002599.CaseDesc: On October 21, 1989, an unidentified man was discovered in the area of County Road 14 in Napanee, Ontario.  Biogeographic ancestry testing predicts that this man was of south Asian ancestry.

Shirt: White, Brand: Pierre Cardin; grey, blue, and red thin stripes

Case reference: 2014003940.CaseDesc: On August 30, 1999, Dana Zelic was seen for the last time at her mother's residence located in Hamilton, Ontario. Dana was known to have connections in the Greater Toronto area and in Brooklyn, New York, in the United States. At the time of her disappearance, Dana left her mother’s home without her medication, identification or personal belongings. All efforts to locate her have returned negative results.

Mark: Left Side Of Neck, Brown beauty mark

Case reference: 2015054218.CaseDesc: On September 19, 2015 Heather Coburn was last seen in the area of Prospect Point, Niagara Falls, New York, United States. At the time of her disappearance, Heather was despondent.

Right Jaw, Dental implant in upper jaw

Case reference: 2014004253.CaseDesc: On October 13, 2000, two boats set off on the Churchill River, bound for Granville Lake in Manitoba. One of the boats began taking on water and experiencing engine trouble. Most of the occupants of the disabled boat transferred to the other boat. However, William Linklater stayed on the disabled boat, attempting to start it. The missing boat was located the next day; however, William was not aboard. He is presumed to have drowned.

Case reference: 2016008144.CaseDesc: Ben Trommels was last seen at his residence in Niagara Falls, Ontario, after being dropped off at 6:00 p.m. on Thursday, February 11, 2016.  It is believed that he left his apartment on foot that evening.  At the time of his disappearance, Ben suffered from mental health issues.

Hair: Brown, Often has a shaved head
Coat: Black, Winter coat with fur trimmed hood

Case reference: 2014005612.CaseDesc: Carol Handy was last seen on March 16, 2011 in Edmonton, Alberta. Her family heard her leave her bedroom at approximately 2:30 am. She has not been heard from since.

Case reference: 2016061151.CaseDesc: On April 29, 2014, a male was recovered from a reservoir behind Energy Ottawa, building #511 at 4 Booth Street, Ottawa. His appendix and gallbladder are present. It is believed that he had been in the water for a few days to a few months.

Hair: Brown, Medium length; balding and face stuble
Teeth: Extensive amount of dental work including root canal, crowns, posts and composite resin fillings.

cigarettes in a white opaque plastic container
a hand drawn map of the Richmond Rd/Churchill Ave area, drawn on a torn off cover of a notepad
folding knife with built in nail file and opener on a ring
3 keys (SM "ILCO" key, Curtis "SC1" & Oscar "WR3" house keys)

Case reference: 2014005110.CaseDesc: On June 3, 2008, at approximately 9:25 p.m., Jaquelyn Latto was seen for the last time as she left the Juliette Place Shelter in Toronto, Ontario. Jaquelyn had told the staff at the shelter that she was going out with her brother.

Case reference: 2014004549.CaseDesc: Anthony Wennekers was seen for the last time in July 2003, downtown Calgary, Alberta.  Anthony suffers from a mental disability and was leading a high risk lifestyle at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2016044292.CaseDesc: Chenel Dubé was last seen on August 10, 1970 in Montreal, Quebec. That evening, he called his mother to tell her that he would be home later. Chenel's vehicle was found 3 days later in the parking lot of a restaurant in Ville Saint-Laurent, Quebec.

Case reference: 2022054729.CaseDesc: Kenneth William Snedden was seen for the last time on October 28, 2022 at 1pm in McAdam, New Brunswick.  Kenneth was seen in his grey GMC Sierra with his ATV (red 2005 Honda TRX350F) in the truck bed to go hunting. His truck was found that same evening on Duck Lake Road in Prospect Ridge, New Brunswick, unattended and the ATV was no longer in the truck bed. On November 5th 2022, Kenneth's ATV was recovered in a marsh area of Dumfries Parish, New-Brunswick. Kenneth has not been heard from or seen since.

Case reference: 2006020099.CaseDesc: On October 1, 1974, Louis Wesley was last seen in Chamberlain Narrows, Lac Seul. He was involved in a boating accident and is presumed to have drowned in the lake, 48 km north of Hudson. His body has never been recovered.

Case reference: 2014003922.CaseDesc: On July 15, 1972, Anthony Zukewich and a friend took a canoe out onto Clearwater Lake, located northeast of The Pas in Manitoba. According to witnesses, both men were under the influence of alcohol and had brought alcohol with them into the canoe. They also noted that the lake was extremely rough due to high winds. The pair were seen departing at around 4:00 p.m., heading towards an area known as Long Point. A Long Point resident told the police that he had seen one person in the red canoe, which was sitting flat, indicating weight in the front. The canoe was recovered on July 17th. Despite extensive search efforts, Anthony was never located.

Case reference: 2013000125.CaseDesc: Bonnie Joan Thomas (born Cooper) of Rollingdam, outside of St. Stephen, New Brunswick, met some friends and went across the U.S.A. border to the Legion in Calais, Maine. They went to a St. Patrick's Day dance and after the evening's celebrations, Bonnie left the Legion alone in her 1973 red Volvo station wagon. Bonnie drove back through the Calais/St. Stephen border crossing into Canada. At the Canadian entry point, Bonnie hit the customs booth causing minor damage to her car and was last seen talking to the Customs Officer. The following morning Bonnie's husband realized she was missing, and called the police. On March 18, 1978, Bonnie's car was found abandoned near St. Stephen on a logging road near the St Croix River.

Case reference: 2007003699.CaseDesc: On April 9, 2007, a male was located in a forested area north of the intersection of Fiddlers Green Road and Glancaster Road in the community of Mount Hope, Hamilton. He is believed to have been deceased for 7 to 8 months and possibly longer.

Hair: Grey, White, Short, 2-3 inches in length
Teeth: Visible Missing, Upper teeth were lost or removed prior to death. Remaining teeth include 1 canine and 2 premolar teeth on each side of lower jaw
Money: $12.99 with one discolored coin, unknown denomination
Shirt: Denim, Blue, "Kinswood" brand long sleeved button down shirt, size large

Case reference: 2012020009.CaseDesc: Kathleen Wattley was last seen on June 13, 1992. It is unusual for Kathleen not to return home to her children. Kathleen was known to live a high risk life style.

Case reference: 2016061381.CaseDesc: On April 25, 1970 a Caucasian male was found in the ravine just north of Beechwood Ave. The ravine was located 300 yards south of the Leaside Bridge and approximately 100 yards east of the Don River.

Other: Rifle - Winchester Model 94 30-30 calibre, with a black and white rifle case

Case reference: 2008006798.CaseDesc: Jason Russell was last seen at the Casino in Niagara Falls. Jason was a student at Brock University in St. Catharines, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014004448.CaseDesc: Carmelo Tomasino was last seen on January 19, 2004 in Montreal, Quebec. Carmelo's absence and not calling home is out of character.

Tattoo: Chest, Hearts with the text "Amanda and Brenda"

Case reference: 2014003491.CaseDesc: On June 12th, 1981, Gordon Westover was seen at a local beer garden in Fort St John, BC at approximately 11:00 PM. Mr. Westover left the gathering in an unknown direction and has not been seen or heard from since. Mr. Westover has a mild mental disability and has been known to impersonate professional people such as police, firefighters, military and doctors. Mr. Westover told several people at the party that he was going to join the military, but no records show Mr. Westover was ever recruited. Mr. Westover has not been seen or heard from.

Case reference: 2023054349.CaseDesc: On October 2, 2023, Kyrylo Yeltsov was reported missing from the IUSMM - Pavillon Bédard in the Mercier-Hochelaga-Maisonneuve District of Montréal, Québec. He hasn't spoken to his mother or any of his friends since, and he's never returned to the hospital. Kyrylo is originally from Ukraine and was feeling despondent at the time of his disappearance.

Hair: Black, Bald, Black hair, currently bald

Case reference: 2014002008.CaseDesc: On September 29, 1999, Pierre Bédard was seen for the last time leaving his home in Levis, Quebec. Pierre's vehicle was located at the Anse Benson park in the St-Romuald neighbourhood in Levis.

Case reference: 2014002868.CaseDesc: On August 2, 1989, Ronald Jack last spoke with his mother. During that telephone discussion, Ronald had informed her that he and his wife, Doreen Jack, would be leaving for a “camp job”. He had also said that they would be gone for approximately 10 days, and would be back before their sons, Russell and Ryan Jack, started their school year in September.

Case reference: 2014001538.CaseDesc: During the month of March, 1998, Theresa Johnny was seen for the last time in Whitehorse, Yukon. The last known contact with Theresa was on July 18, 1998, with the Anchorage Police Department in Alaska, United States. Over the years, there have been a number of unconfirmed tips received about Theresa’s location and well being.

Case reference: 2014003706.CaseDesc: On September 14, 1974, Albert Crow and a friend attempted to cross Harrop Lake, Manitoba, in a canoe, despite high winds and rough water. A second party in another canoe was ahead of Albert's and at one point in the crossing observed that the canoe was no longer visible. The shoreline was searched and the lake dragged without success. On October 12, 1974, the body of his friend was recovered. The cause of his death was later determined to have been by drowning. Albert is also believed to have died as a result of drowning.

Case reference: 2014001875.CaseDesc: On May 25th, 1987 at approximately 9:00 a.m., Rene Parr left his home in Trois-Rivieres, Quebec, where he was living with his sister for the previous 6 months. He was in the process of a divorce and he was scheduled to attend the courthouse the next day. Rene has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014005236.CaseDesc: On May 30, 1973, Françoise Guilbault reportedly left her home in Joliette, Quebec. She left a note for her husband and took a bus to Montreal, Quebec. Françoise has never been seen since.

Case reference: 2016066833.CaseDesc: On April 26, 1982, an unidentified male was discovered in the Detroit River, near Fighting Island. His post-mortem length was estimated as being between 5'6"-5'8",  however, this measurement may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. It is estimated he was in the water for no more than 6 months.

Jacket: Parka or hooded jacket, which had both a zipper and snap fasteners

Case reference: 2006019899.CaseDesc: Frank Uncapher was last seen on Lac Seul on October 21, 1974. He was on a hunting trip.

Case reference: 2014006050.CaseDesc: On April 3, 2013, Patrice Mathieu was reported missing from his home in St-Joseph-de-Sorel, Quebec. Patrice was last seen the day before. Patrice does not own a car, however he does have a driver's licence and he usually travels on foot. Patrice is known to be quiet and is, by nature, anxious and withdrawn.

Coat: Black, Mid-thigh length with a hood
Jeans: Blue, With the bottom rolled up

Case reference: 2020049381.CaseDesc: On November 6, 2020 Sean Hart was last seen leaving Seven Oaks Receiving Home in Victoria, British Columbia.  Sean has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014001487.CaseDesc: On July 21, 1995, Raymond Snakeskin was last seen in Wollaston Lake, Saskatchewan. He had told another individual that he was making a pilgrimage to Zangeza Bay on Reindeer Lake, Saskatchewan, approximately 60 kilometers through the bush. Raymond has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014005036.CaseDesc: Cory Bannerman was seen for the last time when he left work on November 26, 2007, in Edmonton, Alberta. At the time of his disappearance, Cory was despondent.

Case reference: 2018054173.CaseDesc: On September 23, 2018, at approximately 11:00 a.m., Melvin Hillier was last seen at his home in Torbay, Newfoundland & Labrador. Melvin had advised his family that he was going for a drive. Melvin’s blue Ford F-150 pick-up truck was later located abandoned on the MV Legionnaire (one of the ferries that operates between Portugal Cove-St. Phillips and Bell Island, Newfoundland & Labrador). Surveillance footage on the ferry shows Melvin walking around the lounge area during the 1:45 p.m. crossing and he was last observed on video between 1:50 p.m. and 1:57pm.

Case reference: 2018059144.CaseDesc: On October 9, 2018, Johnathan Braithwaite was seen for the last time as he was leaving the CIBC bank located on 45 King Street, in St. Catharines, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, Johnathan was despondent.

Scar: Torso (Front), Scar from two gunshot wounds

Case reference: 2014005757.CaseDesc: Harley Boxall was seen leaving his residence in Nanaimo on March 9, 2012. A suicide note was located in his room suggesting he was going to drown himself. However, within weeks of being reported missing, there were unconfirmed reports of Mr. Boxall within the city of Nanaimo or that he may be residing with the homeless community in Vancouver’s lower-Eastside.

Case reference: 2006023699.CaseDesc: Jeffrey Turtle was last seen in Pikangikum in the Squirrel Rock area in Ontario on July 4, 2005. Information received indicated that Jeffrey was going to a sand pit area approximately 3 km northwest of Pikangikum.

Hat: Blue, Red, Ball Cap, Red "C", Size Large
Sweater: Hooded, Size XL, Black, Red And White

Case reference: 2022060063.CaseDesc: Dustin Ireson's last contact was on November 13, 2022. His black Dodge Ram truck was found abandoned on November 24, 2022, in a parking lot near the Days Inn in Sarnia, Ontario.  During this period, Dustin was experiencing feelings of despondency.  Surveillance footage captured a man believed to be Dustin parking the truck and walking south toward the waterfront.  Despite extensive search efforts, Dustin's whereabouts remained unknown.

Tattoo: Unknown, Maple leaf with #11 in the middle of the leaf.
Right Abdomen, "IRESON" in vertical block letters on the left side

Case reference: 2014003404.CaseDesc: Armand Comtois was reported missing on May 2, 1985. At the time of his disappearance he was living in Saint-Hyacinthe, Quebec. He was seen by a family member on March 9, 1985 but he has not been seen or heard from since this date. He also used the name of "Simon".

Teeth: Dental appliance, partial composed of 4 upper teeth.

Case reference: 2019073733.CaseDesc: On April 20, 2019, Trevor Batoche was seen for the last time in Penticton, British Columbia. Trevor was known to frequently travel to Northern British Columbia and Edmonton, Alberta, possibly driving an older black pickup truck.

Case reference: 2014002912.CaseDesc: On June 29, 1982, Serge Aumont was seen for the last time in the Hochelaga district of Montreal, Quebec. Serge left his mother’s home with a friend to go to a medical clinic. He has not been seen or heard from since.

Foreign Object: Mouth, Upper and lower partial dentures

Case reference: 2008003399.CaseDesc: William Smith was last seen operating a large boat leaving Port Rowan, Ontario at approximately 5:30 pm on June 23, 1983. The boat was seen heading out to the north channel, which would lead into Lake Erie. The boat is described as a white, 31 foot, 1977 Bertram hardtop cruiser with a flying bridge. The hull VIN number is 3121641B and the boat had twin Mercruiser 330 hp engines.

Case reference: 2014005841.CaseDesc: Alfred Sassin has not been seen since he left his home in downtown Vancouver on July 9, 2012. Mr. Sassin's absence was reported to police by the resident caretakers on July 16, as they had not seen him for over a week, which was unusual for him.

Case reference: 2014005768.CaseDesc: On March 16, 2012, Sol Han was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. That day, Sol did not show up for school.

Case reference: 2014005958.CaseDesc: Dallas Broich was last seen at his residence in Edmonton, Alberta, on October 8, 2012. He was supposed to report for work in Fort McMurray, Alberta, the following day but never arrived. Dallas has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2013000083.CaseDesc: On December 4, 1999, Jean-René Duguay was seen for the last time when he was seen jumping off the Lachapelle Bridge in Montreal, Quebec. Jean-René’s body was never found.

Case reference: 2006022599.CaseDesc: Edwin Scherer was last seen while on a hunting trip at Cedar Point Lodge on Gordon Lake. He was on vacation at the time and was a resident of Wisconsin, U.S.A.

Jewelry: Gold, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, watch with 3 black stones
Gold, Blue, Ring, large blue stone
Shirt: Wool, White, Black, lumberjack style; dirty
Vest: Brown, Orange, hunting vest with orange on the shoulders

Case reference: 2014004835.CaseDesc: Ashleigh Pettman was last seen on June 3 2005 in the downtown area of Kelowna, British Columbia. She had moved to Kelowna from Grand Prairie, Alberta in March 2005 to live with her grandmother. In May 2005, Ashleigh gathered her belongings and moved out of her grandmother's residence to an unknown location.

Case reference: 2024019824.CaseDesc: On April 24 2024, Dale Revell was last seen in Merritt, British Columbia. Since that time, there has been  no further contact with him.

Shoes: Black, Red, Adidas brand running shoes
Scar: Left Knee, Long surgical scar on left or right knee
Tattoo: Left Forearm, Faded dragon with cloud and waterfall

Case reference: 2014003020.CaseDesc: On October 7, 1997, Judy Desjarlais and a friend were sitting outside of their shared residence on Cameron Ave, Edmonton, overlooking the North Saskatchewan River. Judy took off running down towards the river. Her friend heard Judy in the river calling for help and went into the water looking for her.

Mark: Chin, Mole on left side of chin
Waist, 2 moles, 1 on each side of the stomach
Scar: Chin, Noticeable scar on left chin

Case reference: 2010003499.CaseDesc:
On March 21, 2010 Chung Law left work on Dundas St, London ON. He told his employer that he was experiencing some stress and would be taking a couple of days off. Chung spoke to his wife, who lives in Vaughan, ON, and told her he was coming home for a visit. He spoke to his employer the next day, saying he was in Toronto and that he did not want to return to work in London. Chung never made it home. Investigation has revealed that he may have travelled to Toronto by bus. 

In April, 2011 a right foot contained within a black boot was located in the river flats of the Thames River in Elgin County. The area was searched and no further remains were found. DNA confirmed that the foot was that of Chung.

Scar: Left Thigh, Surgery scar on upper left thigh

Case reference: 2014005452.CaseDesc: Albert Morris Hopkins departed his cabin on Sunday, November 2, 1975, to go fishing on Lake Athapapuskow in Manitoba. When he failed to return three days later, he was reported missing. Soon thereafter, on November 6th, his boat was located overturned banging against rocks. Despite intensive boat patrols and dragging operations, Albert has not been found. Foul play is not suspected, and it is assumed that he drowned.

Case reference: 2014004181.CaseDesc: On July 2, 1984, Yves Jodouin was seen for the last time as he was dropped off at a venue in Ottawa, Ontario. Yves had received permission to leave the Children’s Hospital of Eastern Ontario to attend a show. Later that evening, he had phoned his family to advise he would be running late.

Case reference: 2013000010.CaseDesc: Jaime Wyatt was reported missing to the St-John's RCMP by family members that he had not been seen since November 12th, 1996. Jaime was a resident of Newfoundland and left the province in September 1996 to seek employment in Nova Scotia. The investigation revealed that Jaime stayed at the Twin Elms Motel on Inglis Street in Halifax, Nova Scotia and he was last seen there on November 16th, 1996. On the evening of November 16th, 1996, Jaime informed the staff at Twin Elms that he was going to be picked up to go to a dinner party that evening.  Jaime was never heard from or seen since that day and foul play is suspected.

Case reference: 2014005457.CaseDesc: On July 7, 2010, Roosdianajati and Didik Harijanto were seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Roosdianajati and Didik were scheduled to work, but did not show up for their shifts.

Case reference: 2020011563.CaseDesc: On July 17, 1988, at approximately 12:00pm, Mosses Korman was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014004477.CaseDesc: In June 1973, Ronald & Theresa Yakimchuk left Edmonton for a wedding in Montreal, driving their 1959 Volkswagen Beetle. It was reported the couple visited an associate in Brandon, Manitoba. They never attended the wedding. The last contact from the couple was a postcard believed to be from Theresa sent from Dryden, Ontario on June 12, 1973.

Jewelry: Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Braided, Wedding band
Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Braided, Wedding ring

Case reference: 2012020083.CaseDesc: On June 4, 1980, John Roy MacLellan, 79 years old, was last seen in Lintlaw, Saskatchewan.  John's medical condition made him, at times, confused. In October of 1980, his vehicle was located in the Usherville district. Searches of that area have failed to locate him.  John was last seen with a full beard.

Case reference: 2018013207.CaseDesc: On the morning of March 12, 2018, Ariel Kouakou left his home, on foot, to go to a friend’s house. At around 11:15 am, a witness walking a dog saw Ariel on the bicycle path in Park of la Merci located between Gouin Boulevard and the Rivière des Prairies.

Case reference: 2014004062.CaseDesc: Steve Langlois left the dock at Port Daniel, Gascons, Quebec on April 27, 1996 on a lobster fishing boat. The boat was then hit by a wave and capsized and Steve has not been found.

Case reference: 2016061229.CaseDesc: On August 7, 1973, a male individual was found on the GO Train tracks near Roncesvalles and the Gardiner, beneath the Sunnyside Walkway, from which he apparently fell/jumped. His post-mortem length was 5’5"-5’8", but due to extensive bone fractures this may not accurately reflect his height. His appendix was not present.

Hair: Short, Straight, Dark, straight hair approximately 2-3" in length
Shirt: Grey, Patterned, may have been blue and white

Case reference: 2014004626.CaseDesc: In March of 1975, Barry “Rocky” Fiddler was reported missing by his family when he failed to return home.  It was learned that he was last seen in July of 1975 at a Powwow at the Thunderchild First Nation, Saskatchewan, which is approximately 1.5 hours from Meadow Lake, Saskatchewan.  Investigation and searches have failed to locate him.

Case reference: 2020007818.CaseDesc: On August 11, 1972, at approximately 12:00pm, Harvey Tulley was seen for the last time by the building’s superintendent in Toronto, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, Harvey was despondent.

Fractured/Broken Bones: Left Thumb, Bent towards index finger

Case reference: 2008003599.CaseDesc: Charlie Campbell was last seen November 6, 1988 in Red Lake Ontario.  It is believed that he drowned.

Case reference: 2023033146.CaseDesc: Winston Seeseequon was last seen June 24, 2023, in the community of South Tallcree First Nation in Alberta.  Winston's clothes were located by the river.  Extensive searches of land, water and air proved negative.

Case reference: 2014022293.CaseDesc: On February 21, 1981, Emery Laboucane left his home to go to work. He called his wife from work, saying he was on his way home, but never returned. His vehicle was later found at Edmonton International Airport in Alberta. Over the course of the following month, Emery's credit cards were used in California, USA, and then usage ceased.

Case reference: 2014002843.CaseDesc: A party of 6 men departed Churchill, Manitoba, on a fishing trip traveling in three canoes. On June 20, 1967, two of the three canoes became stranded on mud flats at a point where the Hayes and Nelson Rivers empty into the Hudson Bay. The men made camp for the night and then the following day Kurt Hild, Ronald Davidson and James Cochrane all attempted to retrieve the stranded canoes. On return to the camp the men were confronted with high winds and freezing rain which forced them out of sight. None of the remains of the men have been recovered. Foul play is not suspected in the matter.

Case reference: 2012020062.CaseDesc: On July 15, 2000, Marcus McKay went hunting with his stepfather and three others.  Marcus and his stepfather broke from the group to hunt on their own. Some time later, the pair had successfully brought down a deer. Marcus was to stay with the deer while his stepfather went to get help from their friends. However, when they returned, Marcus was nowhere to be found. Marcus was last seen approximately 10 km north of the intersection of Mallard and Bison Roads in the community of Mallard, Manitoba.

Case reference: 2014005450.CaseDesc: On June 6, 1979, James Gordon Nevin left his home in Amherstburg, Ontario, for a two-week vacation to visit relatives. He had a grandson in Winnipeg, Manitoba and a son in Prince George, British Columbia. The relatives were not informed of his planned visit.   On June 14, 1979, the RCMP responded to a call and located his 1974 white/maroon Dodge Coronet in a ditch between Rocanville, Saskatchewan and St. Lazare, Manitoba. Investigative findings indicate that the vehicle has been at this location since June 8, 1979.  James' whereabouts are currently unknown and it is believed that he was last seen between 1:30 p.m. and 3:00 p.m. on June 8, 1979. Extensive land and air searches have been conducted, all with negative results. The possibility of foul play cannot be discounted.

Scar: Right Thumb, Skin graft scar on right or left thumb

Case reference: 2018023841.CaseDesc: On May 3, 2018, Colten Fleury was last seen at his mother’s residence in Prince George, British Columbia. Colten has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014001558.CaseDesc: Louis Cochrane was reported missing when his family became concerned about his absence as he had a history of memory loss and a history of running into the bush and/or wandering off. An intensive search of the land proved unsuccessful. A set of footprints were found leading into the water of the river and an intensive operation involving the drilling of 10 holes through the ice in the area failed to yield any evidence. Louis' whereabouts remain unknown.

Teeth: 2 molars absent on upper right side
Fractured/Broken Bones: Left Arm, Left arm in cast

Case reference: 2014004393.CaseDesc: Jean Garnek lived in an apartment block in the McGregor area of the city, where she was known to walk wherever she needed to go. She was also known to use the Winnipeg Transit System.

Case reference: 2014005378.CaseDesc: On September 8, 2004, Robert Harrington was last seen near the intersection of Oakwood Avenue and Vaughan Road in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014001572.CaseDesc: On July 19, 1970, Arthur Stephens left his home in Gimli, Manitoba. He had planned to go fishing in the Whiteshell Provincial Park. Arthur told his wife that he would return on July 21, 1970. He further advised her that if he was going to stay any longer, he would call her to let her know. By July 22, 1970, Arthur had not returned home and his wife hadn't received a phone call. She reported him missing to police that day. On August 1, 1970, Arthur's vehicle was located near Falcon Beach.  Extensive ground, lake and air searches were done of the area. All efforts to locate him failed to uncover any further leads. Arthur`s whereabouts remain unknown.

Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, Circular tattoo (exact design/pattern unknown)

Case reference: 2014005033.CaseDesc: On April 28, 2000, at approximately 9:45 a.m., Kim Mezo was seen for the last time as she left the Branson Hospital in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2013000058.CaseDesc: Marie-Berthe Perreault Astle Wiseman has been missing since June 26, 1975 from Montreal, Quebec. Marie-Berthe was last seen in her home located in the suburb of Pointe-Claire in Montreal before mysteriously disappearing.

On July 2, 1988, an unidentified man was found in the parking lot of the Value Village
on East Hastings Street in Vancouver, British Columbia. The man had suffered from a
heart attack, and the results of his autopsy showed evidence of previous heart damage and a case of mild chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

Case reference: 2006021799.CaseDesc: Leo Payash, was last seen on July 01, 1957. He and his mother Cecilia Payash, were walking on Red Lake Road in Ontario, and neither has been seen since.

Deformity: Nose, Described as having a "hooked" nose

Case reference: 2014004628.CaseDesc: On April 18, 2005, Patrick Marshall was last seen when he left his residence in the North East area of Jean Cote, Alberta. Patrick had left a note indicating that he would be travelling to Calgary with a friend. The note also indicated that he would be in contact within a few weeks. When he left, Patrick left with minimal clothes and toiletries.

Case reference: 2006023799.CaseDesc: On July 12, 1999, Jerzy Ryglewicz was last seen at a gas station in Merrickville, Ontario. He has not been seen or made contact with any friends or family since.

Case reference: 2006017299.CaseDesc: On October 31, 1998, Jake Just attended a party at a residence in the north end of the town of Midland. He was last seen walking home from the party, then separating from his friends to take a short cut through a wooded area. An extensive search of the area turned up negative.

Case reference: 2014006329.CaseDesc: On November 22, 2013, David Czerman was taken to Surrey Memorial Hospital for substance impairment.  Later that day, David discharged himself from the hospital and was given a bus ticket at approximately 19:40 hours. He has not been seen by his neighbours or family since November 21, 2013.
